00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000001.title: The letter arrives
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000001.synopsis: A letter from Mara’s missing father sends her back to the island she promised herself she would never visit again.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000001.notes: Let the opening stay quiet. The letter should feel ordinary until the very last line.

00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000002.title: A map of missing places
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000002.synopsis: Mara finds a second map hidden inside her childhood atlas. Its coastline changes when she looks away.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000002.notes: The map is a record of memory, not geography. Don’t explain this yet.

00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000003.title: The last ferry
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000003.synopsis: At the mainland harbor, a reluctant ferryman recognizes Mara’s name—and knows more than he is willing to say.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000003.notes: Introduce Tomas through what he does, not a description. He should never answer a question directly.

00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000004.title: What the tide kept
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000004.synopsis: The crossing reveals how much the island has changed. A familiar landmark appears on the wrong side of the boat.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000004.notes: A quiet scene between discoveries. Give Mara space to remember.

00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000005.title: The lighthouse keeper
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000005.synopsis: An old family friend offers Mara a room and an unsettling warning: some things on the island are better left unremembered.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000005.notes: Elin is warm, practical, and keeping one enormous secret.

00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000006.title: Mara Vale
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000006.synopsis: A cartographer who trusts measurements more than memories. She left Bellwether at sixteen.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000006.notes: Her arc is about accepting uncertainty without losing her sense of self.

00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000007.title: Bellwether Island
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000007.synopsis: An island whose geography follows memory. The places its residents forget begin to disappear.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000007.notes: Keep a consistent relationship between memory and the landscape.

00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000008.title: Tomas Reyes
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000008.synopsis: The ferryman who took Mara’s father to the island and has never said what was spoken on the crossing.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000008.notes: Never lets him answer a question directly. Weather first, then people.

00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000009.title: Elin Marsh
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000009.synopsis: The lighthouse keeper who drew the first map of the changing coastline and still visits the places that vanish.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000009.notes: Warm and unhurried. She chooses which truths arrive first.
